{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df["patient_id"].duplicated().sum()}')

# Check how many have biomarker_baseline == -999
print(f'Number with biomarker_baseline == -999: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check for multiple sample_seq per patient
sample_seq_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {sample_seq_counts[sample_seq_counts > 1].count()}')

# Check which assay_batch has which unit
print(f'Assay batch distribution: {df["assay_batch"].value_counts().to_dict()}')

# Check if arm and severity are balanced
print(f'Arm distribution: {df["arm"].value_counts().to_dict()}')
print(f'Severity distribution: {df["severity"].value_counts().to_dict()}')

# Check if severity is confounded with arm
print(f'Arm vs severity cross-tab:
{pd.crosstab(df["arm"], df["severity"])}')"}
